configurationProjection.settings: Known setting keys and validated primitive values only; shortcuts limited to recognized commands/key syntax; absolute paths excluded, including embedded obvious Unix/Windows drive/UNC paths in free text.
configurationProjection.legacyConnections: Omitted from defaults/effective settings, rejected by settings_patch, stripped from loaded global/project objects and subsequent settings writes.
configurationProjection.appearance: Known layout/theme/mode/geometry/color/background/preset/asset fields only; unknown nested fields excluded; preset names containing recognizable absolute paths omitted.
configurationProjection.credentials: No credential index, secrets, agent connection records, document bodies or arbitrary source strings are read into export.

frontendRuntimeDiagnostics.values: Complete nonnegative safe-integer counter set; no identifiers/text/paths; kept separate from native subscription counts.

credentials.read: credential-index.json persistence is authoritative. session reads memory only and expires after HostState restart. Missing/unregistered refs are unavailable.
credentials.systemToSession: Stage index first; read/delete only the same Horizon Keyring ref, then atomically commit session index and update memory. Delete failure preserves old index/memory; commit failure restores old system key; restoration failure is explicitly OUTCOME_UNKNOWN.
credentials.systemSave: Stage changed index before writing system credential; failed index commit deletes newly written system key and reports any cleanup failure as OUTCOME_UNKNOWN. Existing session memory changes only after index commit.
credentials.remove: Touches only indexed Horizon ref. Keeps memory until system deletion and index write succeed.
credentials.plaintextPersistence: Only metadata/reference/persistence written in credential-index.json; key values are not serialized.
